content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [article_no] [version_no] and want to configure 4 timers with the same parameter. On the [product_name] display, I prefer to set only one value for all of them. It seems there is an option to reference a value from another timer during programming, but when I test it, it doesn't work as expected. Are there alternative approaches or any examples available?
You could use an arithmetic function for this purpose.
I've previously used Up/Down Counters as a reference point, which worked for me.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to configure multiple timers using a shared value through a reference on the [product_name] display with [version_no], but encounters functionality issues. Community members suggest using arithmetic operations and counters as alternative solutions, highlighting that the built-in referencing feature might not work reliably in this setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to set a single timer value via the display and apply it to several timers automatically, ideally by leveraging the built-in reference functionality.
